page.overview:
Who is Anuli?

Anuli was a Human male slicer who served the Hutt underboss, Gele'ren, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Anuli grew up alongside fellow slicer, Mako, who regarded him as her little brother.

In 3643 BBY, but was killed by one of the Eidolon's assassin droids before the hunter was able to save him, along with Gele'ren.

Before Anuli was killed, he uploaded Eidolon Security's private database records on to the HoloNet, a severe blow to the company's business.
